lia_people_ops: Quick heads-up — we're running a 'Recognition Roadshow' the week of Jun 14. Pop-up table in SF + remote swag drops for anyone who nominates a teammate. Need 2 volunteers per 2-hr shift and one person to pick up swag from vendors. Sign-up sheet below. TL;DR: short shifts, stickers + hoodies for winners, $250 microgrant for 3 selected noms. Any conflicts?

sam_engineering: I'm available Mon/Tue morning. Can we do an evening slot for APAC folks? :earth_asia:

tanya_hr: Sounds great. Quick Q — are managers allowed to nominate their direct reports? Policy check pls.

lia_people_ops: Yes, managers can nominate but all manager nominations go into the blind review queue; panel members don't see submitter names. We'll add that as a checkbox in the form and include the review rubric.

mike_ops: Can we use the Ops table on 4F? Need a power strip + small TV for the raffle screen. @facilities to confirm.

facilities_bot: Booking request submitted for 4F ops table (req #4521), ETA approval 24–48h.

joan_ceo: love this — happy to swing by Fri afternoon for 15 mins :heart:

lia_people_ops: thanks! Added a 'lead visit' slot. Signup link: https://forms.gle/roadshow-signup (use code `ROADSHOW`). Please add dietary needs for snacks. Volunteers — mark your Slack status with :roadshow: and we'll DM shift checklists.

sam_engineering: added myself to Mon morning. I can bring extra stickers and a few promo cards.

lia_people_ops: awesome thanks Sam — I'll add you to the volunteer doc and share access to the vendor pickup checklist.
